tagline: 理光取景器相机，1976 年发布
description: 理光于1976年推出的取景器相机。配备Rikenon f 2.8 / 40mm。快门速度Ricoh, Speeds 1/8 - 1/500 sec + B。使用35mm。zone focus with 3 symbols (1m, 2.5m, infinity).。

specs.曝光测光: manual shutter speed selection, aperture controlled by CdS meter or manually.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh 35 ZF is a viewfinder camera with a fixed lens from 1976, the first model to made by Ricoh in Taiwan.
